verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a published region list or per-region service availability matrix (e.g., cloud.google.com/about/locations or product availability tables); only status/incident pages (docs-17, docs-23) which address uptime, not region/service selection for planning. Missing for 10: a region catalog page, a per-service region availability matrix, and any documented tool/API to query which services are available in which region before deployment.
